recent.item: Q2 FY27 board meeting/results & call scheduled (no Q2 FY27 broker previews found as of 23-Oct). Q1 FY27 backdrop: ~10% FY27 domestic vol guidance; supply-constrained; ~130k pending orders, 13-day dealer stock; Elara expects GM recovery on Jun/Jul price hikes.

Festive: retail +35% YoY Ganesh Chaturthi-Dussehra (small cars +16%, SUVs ~2x); Navratri alone flat vs FADA industry registrations -21.9%; pending bookings 2.0 -> 2.7 lakh after Dussehra; expects double-digit festive growth to Diwali. Oct-2026 monthly sales due 1-Nov.
RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% (first hike since Feb-2023), stance to "calibrated tightening"; FY27 GDP 7.1%, CPI 5.2%.
CAFE-III final norms notified (Apr-2027 to Mar-2032): no separate small-car (<=909kg) 3 g/km relief; reference weight raised 1,170 -> 1,229 kg and flatter curve; EV super-credits retained.
India-EU FTA EV terms (proposal): duty cut from up to 110% to 30% on up to 20k EVs from FTA year 5; cars <EUR20k CIF excluded.
SW monsoon ended at ~87% of LPA (-12.6%), weakest since 2015; El Nino; 17/36 subdivisions deficient - rural demand risk.
Delhi petrol Rs102.12/l, diesel Rs95.20/l (after 2026 hikes; one report of a further Rs3.13/2.71 hike on 18-Oct unverified).

Launch pipeline (media, unconfirmed): Brezza & Baleno facelifts, 7-seat Grand Vitara before Mar-2027; YMC 3-row EV MPV (e Vitara platform) by ~Mar/H1-2027; Y43 compact SUV; new hybrid Baleno late-2026/2027.
Stock at 52-week low ~10,984; -32.6% over 52 weeks; consensus TP Rs15,423 (39 analysts).
